summary.text: Rachel Gross is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 78, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A registered nurse, she said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that she has lived in the 78th District her entire life.

paragraphs.text: Rachel Gross was born in Lansing, Michigan, graduated from St. Patrick's High School, earned an associate degree from Montcalm Community College in 1997 and a bachelor's degree from American Sentinel University in 2024.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nurse, and in the survey she said she is approaching her 30th year of service as a registered nurse.
She said she is married and the mother of four adult children, and that she has been a Girl Scout leader, PTO parent and team parent.
Gross listed three campaign priorities: education funding, healthcare access and affordable housing.

On healthcare, she said she would work to expand access through telehealth services and mobile health units, and to direct Michigan's rural health transformation funding toward attracting more providers to the district.
